summary: Iteration 6 tests two new features: Voice Personality (5-voice ElevenLabs catalog with per-user persistence) + Ambient Loop (idempotent Sora 2 ensure-ambient). Backend: 9/9 pytest passed (test_voice_ambient.py) — GET /api/tts/voices returns 5 voices + current, POST /api/tts/voice persists selection (verified via subsequent GET), unknown voice_id -> 400 'Voz no disponible.', unauth -> 401. POST /api/tts/speak with no body.voice_id correctly falls back to user.voice_id (Matilda) and returns 200 audio/mpeg. POST /api/media/ensure-ambient first call returns {started:true, status:'pending'} and creates media_jobs doc with kind='video', prompt='ambient-idle', ambient=true; second call idempotent (started:false, same job_id); pre-seeded 'done' doc also returns started:false; unauth -> 401. Frontend: /dashboard with seeded session cookie shows voice-selector-trigger (label starts as 'Sarah'), clicking opens voice-selector-menu with exactly 5 option buttons; clicking Matilda closes menu, fires POST /api/tts/voice, shows sonner toast 'Elena adopta la voz "Matilda" 💋', and updates trigger label to 'Matilda'. Ambient endpoint fires exactly 1 POST on mount (verified with 2 consecutive full page reloads — server-side idempotency confirmed). voice-toggle-button still renders next to VoiceSelector. Chat streaming regression: sending 'Hola Elena, prueba' -> 1 POST /api/chat/stream, Elena reply rendered, 1 POST /api/tts/speak (200 audio/mpeg) fires with Matilda voice. Dropdown z-[80] + rgba(8,8,10,0.98) renders cleanly above chat panel (screenshot shows toast + trigger label update — no overlap issue).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L499-531 /api/media/ensure-ambient correctly guards on {status: {$in:['done','pending']}} and sorts by created_at desc — idempotency is solid. If a prior job fails, a new one will kick off (good).
server.py L818-834 /api/tts/voices validates voice_id against ELENA_VOICE_CATALOG membership before persisting — safe.
server.py L846 falls back to user.voice_id then DID_ELEVENLABS_VOICE_ID (Sarah) if user has never picked — clean.
VoiceSelector.jsx L37-54 correctly early-returns when clicking already-selected voice, and closes menu whether success or failure.
Dashboard.jsx L58 ambientApi.ensure() is fire-and-forget (.catch(()=>{})) — appropriate since backend enforces idempotency.

Minor nit: VoiceSelector.jsx L58 hides component entirely if voices.length===0, which is fine, but consider a skeleton if /api/tts/voices ever fails silently — currently the whole selector disappears without any feedback.
Minor nit: no e2e verification that the actual audio sample audibly uses Matilda vs Sarah (headless), but backend confirms voice_id is passed to ElevenLabs URL — logical correctness is assured.
